name: La Ceiba patch 5
waterAreaDefinition: Water surface = every valid pixel the model did not classify as Clouds (class 6). MARIDA has no land class, so any land in the scene is counted as water.

densityGrid.method: Blocks of 25 x 25 source pixels. Coverage = debris pixels of the kept detections / imaged pixels in the block. A detection takes the level of the block holding most of its pixels. Hotspots join 8-adjacent High and Critical blocks (Moderate when there are none).
